28.scope: one production-command scenario connecting captured land, paid necropolis and sustained public summon
authoredSetupAllowed: canonical Undead captor, worker and Gravecaller on legal visible ground
a capturable territory marker initially owned by opponent, not already captured by player
sufficient initial resource wallet, initially no corpses, completed necropolis or raised actors; insert one fresh authored corpse only after capture and construction

productionActions.purpose: complete public capture until marker owner is the Undead player
pay and construct near that captured marker, within local support area

productionActions.setup: insert one fresh corpse record beside the ready Gravecaller after the necropolis completes

minimalAssertions: Public capture completes and changes the opponent-owned marker to player ownership before construction.
Paid necropolis is created at progress0 near the captured marker, resources fall by actual definition cost, the worker builds it to progress1.
Public Gravecaller ability accepted; corpse consumed; new raised actor uses canonical undead melee definition with its ordinary initial remaining lifetime (35 seconds in current source).

After advancing longer than that ordinary initial lifetime while the troop remains within six tiles and on the necropolis level, troop HP is still positive and remaining lifetime is preserved by support.
optionalExistingEvidence: Local healing and unsupported expiry are already directly asserted in the passed necropolis sustain case; combining them here is optional.

28.knownEvidenceItCompletes: Paid construction, actual canonical summoning/lifetime support and capture/recapture all pass separately; no recorded case composes those actions on the captured ground.
28.automaticRaiseQualification: Normal stepGame invokes Gravecaller raising automatically. An initial nearby corpse can be consumed during capture/construction, so the planned public raise must immediately follow insertion of its fresh corpse.
